Juli (People Ops): Priya (new SWE) flagged her passport renewal delay. Start date Mon. Need I-9 solution + laptop for day 1.
Rory (Hiring Manager): We prefer keep start if possible. Remote day 1 ok?
Priya (New Hire): Remote is fine. I can visit a local notary in Bangalore within 48h. Also my router is flaky  would like a loaner.
Juli (People Ops): Notary + Agent Authorization form works. Priya, please upload passport photo + renewal receipt to secure intake: https://redwood-internal/onboard-upload (72h).
onboard-bot: Secure upload link sent.
Priya (New Hire): Uploaded passport scan and renewal receipt. Notary: "Bangalore Notary House, Koramangala".
Sam (IT): We can ship a corporate loaner (Win laptop). Need shipping addr and courier preference. Standard ETA 3 business days.
Priya (New Hire): Shipping: 7th Main Rd, Koramangala 2nd Block, Bangalore 560034, India. Courier: DHL fine.
Juli (People Ops): Benefits: enrollment opens on first paid day; we'll send recorded walkthrough. Payroll: expect India tax residency forms on day 1.
Rory (Hiring Manager): I'll approve remote-first day. Team will host virtual lunch.
Juli (People Ops): Summary: 1) Priya to complete notary visit + keep receipt; 2) IT to ship loaner (ticket IT-6233); 3) Payroll to push tax forms on day 1. Escalate to me if any blocker. :thumbsup:
